items.title: 7.4 Safe and Responsible Information Utilization (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of safe information use (PDF 185).

blocks.text: Maloomat ka zimmedarana istemal ka matlab us ka maakhaz samajhna, us ki motabar hone ki parakh aur ehtiyat se istemal hai.

blocks.prompt: Aaj maloomat ka zimmedarana istemal zyada ahem kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Online maloomat, ghalat bhi, foran phailti hai, to be-ehtiyati se share karna jaldi bohat se logon ko gumrah kar sakta hai.

items: Maloomat mehfooz istemal karein: maakhaz jaanein, aitbaar parkhein, zimmedari se istemal karein.
